resources.string: The app is up to date.
Tap to see what\'s new and update.
StrataOS app %1$s is ready to install
Confirm the installation in the window Android shows.
Android must allow StrataOS to install apps: open the setting, turn on \"Allow from this source\", then come back.
The app only checks when you tap Check for updates.
Checks once a day and tells you when a new version is out.
Installs new versions by itself. Android 12 and later install them without asking; older versions show Android\'s confirmation.
Pre-releases to try the next version early. They may have bugs.
Each download is checked against the checksums of its release, and must be signed with the same key as the installed app: Android refuses an app signed with another key.
The NAS runs StrataOS %1$s and this app is %2$s: update the app.
This release has no Android app file.
The checksum list (SHA256SUMS) of this release is missing or does not list the app: it was not installed.
The downloaded file does not match its checksum: it was not installed.

This app is not signed with the same key as the installed one, so it was not installed (Android would refuse it anyway). To change where the app comes from, uninstall it and install the new one by hand.
The downloaded file is not the StrataOS app.
The downloaded app is not newer than the installed one.
